job.title: Welder/Fabricator
job.description:

This is a hands-on role for a skilled tradesperson with strong TIG welding, stainless steel and fabrication experience who is confident taking a job from preparation through to completed fabrication and finishing.

You will work from engineering drawings, accurately measure and prepare materials, fabricate and fit components, complete high-quality welds, and ensure finished work meets required dimensional and quality standards.

The initial contract runs through to the end of the year, with a strong possibility of extension for the right person depending on performance and ongoing project requirements.

What’s On Offer
  • Contract through to the end of the year
  • Strong potential for extension
  • Consistent project work
  • Competitive pay based on experience
  • Variety of welding and fabrication work
  • Opportunity to utilise both TIG welding and broader fabrication skills
  • Potential for longer-term opportunities based on performance and project requirements
What You’ll Be Doing
  • TIG welding, particularly stainless steel
  • MIG welding and other welding processes where required
  • Fabricating stainless steel and carbon steel components
  • Reading and interpreting engineering and fabrication drawings
  • Measuring, marking, cutting and preparing materials
  • Setting up, fitting and tack welding components
  • Fabricating brackets, frames, supports and other components
  • Working with pipe, tube, sheet and structural materials
  • Modifying and repairing existing components
  • Grinding, finishing and preparing welds to a high standard
  • Fitting and assembling fabricated components
  • Carrying out general mechanical and fabrication work
  • Troubleshooting and making practical fabrication adjustments
  • Checking completed work against drawings and measurements
  • Maintaining a safe, clean and organised work area
  • Working effectively with other trades and project team members
What We’re Looking For
You will ideally have:
  • Proven experience as a Welder/Fabricator
  • Strong TIG welding skills
  • Good stainless steel welding experience
  • Experience working with carbon steel
  • Strong fabrication and fitting skills
  • Ability to confidently read and interpret drawings
  • Accurate measuring and material preparation skills
  • Good understanding of welding and fabrication processes
  • Strong mechanical aptitude
  • High attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently without constant supervision
  • Strong practical problem-solving skills
  • Reliable work ethic and positive attitude
  • Pride in producing high-quality workmanship
Industry Experience
Previous experience within dairy, food processing, manufacturing, industrial processing or similar environments would be advantageous, particularly where stainless steel fabrication and high-quality workmanship are required.
However, this is not essential. Candidates with strong welding and fabrication experience from other industries are encouraged to apply.

job.title: Front of House Concierge
job.description:

We are seeking a professional and personable Concierge to deliver a high-quality front-of-house experience in a corporate workplace in Te Aro, Wellington. SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Professional presentation and communication style

job.description:
Staffing Agency, a national recruitment company, is seeking an experienced Automotive Technician / WOF Inspector for a well-established New Zealand-owned automotive service business in Cambridge.

Your key responsibilities will include:
  • Conduct WOF inspections in accordance with NZTA requirements and accurately document inspection outcomes
  • Complete general servicing, preventative maintenance and mechanical repairs
  • Diagnose mechanical and electrical faults using appropriate diagnostic equipment
  • Inspect and repair brakes, suspension, exhaust systems, tyres, batteries and related components
  • Maintain accurate workshop records while following all health, safety and quality procedures
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
  • Qualified and experienced Automotive Mechanic / Automotive Technician
  • Current NZ WOF Inspector authority
  • Proven experience in WOF inspections, diagnostics and fault-finding
  • Strong practical knowledge of servicing, brakes, suspension and general mechanical repairs

Experience working with EVs, hybrids, European vehicles or 4x4s would be advantageous.
